title: Fairgames cancelled by PlayStation after playtest ❌
subject: fairgames
description:
Should Sony stop chasing live-service shooters? 👇

PlayStation has cancelled Fairgames, Haven Studios' live-service shooter revealed in 2023. Bloomberg reported on November 10, 2026 that an internal email from Sean Decker and John Doyle said playtest feedback and retention fell short of goals. PlayStation says there will be no layoffs at Haven.

Sources: Bloomberg (Nov 10, 2026), VGC (Nov 10, 2026), tbreak (Nov 11, 2026)

scenes.text: Bloomberg broke the news on November 10, citing an email from executives Sean Decker and John Doyle.
A recent playtest ran smoothly, but player feedback and retention fell short of Sony's goals.
The email also blamed tough market conditions for PvP shooters.
scenes.search: online shooter game monitor dark room

scenes.text: Haven Studios in Montreal, founded by Jade Raymond in 2021, first showed the game in 2023.
Nobody at Haven loses their job. The team will now support other PlayStation Studios projects.
